supported_evaluations.display_name: Architecture: replicas for a single-process Node service

supported_evaluations.change_summary: Baseline is one Node.js replica behind nginx. The candidate adds a second identical replica; Redis stays shared. This app is single-process, so no worker-count candidate is claimed.

A restart challenge measures gateway recovery.
